_note: Analyst-style questions written in customer words, which deliberately differ from the policy wording. Synthetic.

questions.question: Customer says they cannot pay their EMI this month. What happens to the loan?
questions.why_tricky: The brief's own example: 'EMI' and 'cannot pay' never appear in the clause, which says 'instalment' and 'repayment default'

questions.question: Customer lost their job and wants a break from loan payments for a while
There is a purchase on my card that I never made
questions.why_tricky: Near-duplicate CC-04 (merchant dispute) is also about a card payment the customer is unhappy with

questions.question: I paid my credit card bill two days late, will I be charged anything?
questions.why_tricky: Near-duplicate LN-04 is a late payment charge on loans

questions.question: How long does the bank have to reply to my complaint?
questions.why_tricky: Near-duplicate CP-03 also gives a complaint response time

questions.question: I have moved house recently, what do I need to send you?
questions.why_tricky: 'moved house' vs 'changes residential address'; KY-01 also asks for proof of address

questions.question: Is there a penalty if I pay off my personal loan early?
questions.why_tricky: 'pay off early' and 'penalty' vs 'settle' and 'early settlement charge'; LN-05 also mentions early settlement

questions.question: The shop never delivered the item I paid for with my card
